amendments.what: Amendment 1 (before any scored read): planted-head training extended from 300 to 3000 steps (checkpoints 10/30/100/300/1000/3000), lr and every other setting unchanged; the read is still the first checkpoint that clears the gate. Stage 0 code fix: the |D| check compares each task with its own E248 items' n_windows (it compared with the set over all items, which includes five 75-window known-answer items).
amendments.why: stage 0 job 64821: the v_proj plant (one head, 128 rows) reached a log-odds gain of 1.42 at step 300 with 0 argmax flips, so it never cleared the e58/copy gate (N 0, L 0.035); E58's 300 steps were sized for all matrices, not one head. Gate and every bar unchanged. The |D| miss was a code bug: every task read 512, as its own items do.

amendments.what: Amendment 2 (cost guard only; no reading or bar touched): rerun_over 1.5 -> 2.5 so the remaining stage-1 items can run on cluster debug L40s at $0; shards resplit as --shard I 6 for I in 1,2,4,5 (shards 0 and 3 of 6 are exactly the finished shard 0 of 3).
amendments.why: the stage-0 estimate is from an H100; job 64985 (L40) ran its first 4 items in 1160 s against 757 s estimated (ratio 1.53) and its guard stopped it. 2.5 = 1.53 x the original 1.5 margin, rounded up. Pods would pass the cell cap ($11.11 spent of $20; 52 items x 2 min on one H100 plus set-up is about $9).

what: Whole-group head CMAP (cross-model activation patching after Prakash et al., ICLR 2024) on the 67M: per item (E237's 15 key items and both sides of E187's nine pairs), the head circuit found on the fine-tune by the authors' path patching and the paper-first minimality rule, then W0 run on the definition's rows D with the circuit's heads given the fine-tune's outputs before W_O. The compared scalar is the whole-circuit CMAP log-odds share on D (neuron_r.shares' form: mean numerator over mean gain); the A+B share is reported for every item.

rules.gate: an item's shares are reported only if its correct-count gain on D exceeds N of its task and scale (at least 1 when N = 0) and its log-odds gain G exceeds both L and 1
rules.compared: the whole-circuit CMAP log-odds share on D, (mean log-odds patched - W0's) / (mean log-odds fine-tune - W0's), not clipped; compared with the definition within a format only (kv, E62 'last', E53 'next'); the A+B share beside it for every item
rules.beside: per group (A, B, C, A+B, whole, 10 matched random sets): patched accuracy on D and its share; faithfulness F(Cir)/F(M) on D with each random set's overlap with the circuit; the pool sizes under m < -2 se and m < 0; p(clean label | noise prompt) under the fine-tune and W0
rules.no_call: a share whose gain is 0 is null; an item that does not clear its gate reports its numbers with compared shares null
rules.pairs_card: filed 2026-11-23 by the lead before any run (card experiments/cmap/card.md). For each of E187's nine built pairs, d = compared share (whole circuit; for E53 whole = A+B) of the side E187 labels reuse minus that of the side it labels new, both at E187's scale. A pair is readable only if both sides clear their gate. With fewer than 5 readable pairs: no call. Rival A: d > 0.07 on at least two thirds of readable pairs (rounded up) AND median d > 0.07. Rival B: median |d| <= 0.07. Neither: no call (also when both hold, which cannot happen since A needs median d > 0.07). Ties at exactly 0.07 count against A. Reported as a baseline column; no reuse verdict on any single fine-tune.

expected.faithfulness: the paper's own-circuit 0.99-1.0 and cross-model 0.88-0.97, for reference only

blind_to: a fine-tune's change to o_proj and to every MLP after the patched sites (the swap uses the base's W_O and the base's MLPs; plant_o shows it); B and C discovery has only the two-layer mechanics check, no planted head
positive_control: plant_v (share 1 through discovery, pruning and CMAP); null: the do-nothing, the wrong head and position, plant_o
